Explains that ordinary color conversion is distinct from changing physiological observers

cases.brief: Adapt our color(display-p3 0.6 0.3 0.2) accent for an sRGB-only report. Preserve the source and explain the fallback.

Records source space and destination mapping

cases.brief: Explain the difference between a 50/50 light mixture of black and white and an even-looking UI gradient, then implement a suitable gradient in the existing stack.

Does not assume the renderer composites alpha in linear light
Checks intermediate gradient regions and actual text adjacency
